messages.subject: Offset variable and glm for stat_smooth
parts:
Dear list memebers,

How can I include an offset variable when fitting a poisson model?

Aslo, Is it possible to use a glm option for the method in stat_smooth (plot builder).

Best,

Manuel

On Sat, Jun 30, 2012 at 6:41 AM, <mspin...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Dear list memebers,
>
> How can I include an offset variable when fitting a poisson model?

double click on an item in the right hand list in the model builder
and add the appropriate offset(...) term.

>
> Aslo, Is it possible to use a glm option for the method in stat_smooth (plot
> builder).

Hum,... is the glm option new? I'll see about adding it in the next
version of Deducer, but no promises.


ian
